page.summary: Why travelers choose JVTO: police-led safety, verifiable credentials, private-only tours, and documented history.
page.answerFirst: JVTO is a registered Indonesian tour operator for private Bromo, Ijen, Tumpak Sewu and Papuma routes from Surabaya or Bali. The model is Tourist Police-led, NIB 1102230032918, 100% private, all-inclusive, and backed by published policies, crew profiles, reviews and verification pages.

lede: Java Volcano Tour Operator (JVTO) is a registered Indonesian tour operator based in Bondowoso, East Java. We specialize in private volcano trips—Bromo, Ijen, and selected extensions.
Every tour is private with no shared groups, backed by a documented Plan-B framework for volcanic closures and credentials you can check before you book.
Practical rulebook (steps, packing, safety, payments): /travel-guide. Binding terms: /policy/.

sections.title: The JVTO Difference
sections.heading: Six differentiators,
sections.lede_text: Not marketing language — every one is backed by a credential you can check. Tap a pillar to see what proves it.

blocks.alt: Agung Sambuko (Mr. Sam), Founder of Java Volcano Tour Operator.

items.label: Police-led
items.title: Police-Led Safety Authority
items.text: Our founder is an active Tourist Police (POLPAR) officer for Bondowoso, the regency that holds the Kawah Ijen access route. No other East Java operator is led by an active Tourist Police officer.

items.label: 100% private
items.title: 100% Private Tours
items.text: A dedicated vehicle, driver, and guide assigned to your group only. No shared groups, no mixed itineraries, no timing compromises.

items.label: All-inclusive
items.title: All-Inclusive Clarity
items.text: Transport, accommodation, permits, water and safety gear written into the price. If it is not on the E-Voucher, it is not included.

items.label: Ijen screening
items.title: Ijen Health-Screening
items.text: Mandatory for every guest under BBKSDA SE.1658/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/9/2024 — we coordinate a BSrE-signed surat sehat through an SIP-licensed doctor, checked at the crater gate.

items.label: Licenses
items.title: Verifiable Licenses
items.text: NIB, TDUP, HPWKI-credentialed guides, BBKSDA clearance, registered ISIC provider and INDECON network listing — a proof library, not a logo wall.

items.label: Plan B
items.title: Plan B Framework
items.text: Documented alternative routes activated when a site closes or conditions change — a written SOP published before you book.

sections.title: Community Standards
sections.heading: Read the rulebook
sections.lede_text: We publish what we don't do as plainly as what we do. Every policy is online before you pay.

items.heading: We don't operate shared groups
items.body: Every tour is private to your booking — a dedicated vehicle, driver, and guide for your group alone.

items.heading: We don't make verbal promises
items.body: The E-Voucher is the binding document. If it is not on the voucher, it is not included.

items.heading: We don't guarantee natural phenomena
items.body: Blue Fire is a natural phenomenon subject to weather and gas activity — it cannot be guaranteed. We plan around the viewing window; we don't promise outcomes we can't control.
items.note: drift-ok: canonical negation — states the phenomenon cannot be guaranteed (facts-lock compliant)

items.heading: We don't source crew from marketplaces
items.body: Every guide and driver is a named, registered team member recruited from local Bondowoso and Banyuwangi communities. Separately, JVTO is publicly listed in the INDECON ecotourism network — the listing is verifiable on the INDECON site.

sections.title: National Media Verification
sections.heading: Duty first, business second.
sections.body_text: Our founder, Bripka Agung Sambuko, was covered by national media (Detik.com) for his dedication as a Tourist Police officer keeping visitors safe in the extreme conditions of Kawah Ijen.
sections.quote: The important thing is that the people who travel are safe.
